hooks.text: 探索真正无限且程序生成的技能树，不断开放新扇区让成长结构自行扩张。
hooks.excerpt: In an abstract world ruled by numbers, you’ll grow exponentially stronger through a truly infinite, procedurally generated skill tree.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 角色会自动开火，玩家唯一需要持续操作的是管理不断扩张的技能树。
hooks.excerpt: You fire automatically. No action is required other than interacting with the skill tree.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 数字同时代表生命与体型；失败会跌回“1”，但已经取得的升级会保留。
hooks.excerpt: Your number isn’t just your Health —it’s also your size . The bigger your number, the larger and more powerful you become. But be careful: one defeat sends you all the way back to “1” , though you’ll keep your upgrades when you restart.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 极简视觉保持了信息清晰易读。

excerpts.excerpt: the minimalist visuals ensure that information remains easy to read.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 技能点短缺会拖累体验。

excerpts.excerpt: skill point shortage hold it back.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 购买升级会稀释能力强度，反而提高难度。

excerpts.excerpt: Buying upgrades makes the game harder, since your ability power gets diluted.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 约一小时后就容易感到无聊。

excerpts.excerpt: Became bored after the first hour.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: please add a search function to the skill tree
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 技能树扩大后难以导航。
挂机推进缺少实际奖励。

excerpts.excerpt: No real reward for idling to get to the next wave.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 任务会引导玩家进行有针对性的属性专精。

excerpts.excerpt: The quests can guide you to min-max one stat specifically for a while
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 多重射击形成了舒缓的清场体验。

excerpts.excerpt: Has that soothing effect of watching all your problems burst away...
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
